description: This file defines the PricingService interface for calculating product prices and formatting monetary amounts within the shopizer e-commerce platform. It includes methods for calculating final prices based on product details, customer info, attributes, and for formatting these prices for display purposes.

classes.name: PricingService
classes.description: Interface for services related to product item price calculation and formatting in the shopizer platform.

methods.name: calculateProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price of a product considering prices and rebates. Overloaded to include customer and attribute considerations.

methods.name: getDisplayAmount
methods.description: Returns a formatted display string for a monetary amount, considering store and locale details.

methods.name: getStringAmount
methods.description: Returns a string representing the amount without currency symbol for display within the store.
